Test Case Title: TC0001_Check creating a simulation
Description: Validate Admins should be able to create simulation successfully
Precondition: User should have admin or Content publisher role
Steps:
1. Login to the app
2. Navigate to hey sales
3. Create a simulation
Expected Result:
1. Admin should be able to login 
2. Hey sales module should render
3. Admin should be able to create a simulation from scratch
Actual Result: Admins are able to create simulation successfully

Description: Validate the call extracted under Account A should not be visible under Account B
Precondition:
1. Account A and Account B exist in the system.
2. User has valid access to both accounts
3. A call extraction process is completed for Account A.
Steps:
1. Login as learner from account A
2. Create a simulation
3. Click on add source, Upload a call
4. Login as learner from account B
5. Create a simulation
6. Click on add source and check the list
Expected Result:
1. Learner from account A should be able to login
2. Simulation should be ceated
3. Learner should be able to upload a call from local
4. Learner from account B should be able to login
5. Simulation should be created
6. The call extracted under Account A should not be visible under Account B
Actual Result: The call extracted under Account A is not visible under Account B
